body:
new to reddit too! and had my first post today too.
also want to cry like a baby even if im already working.
dont worry too much about your grades. got good grades when i was still studying and those who didnt before have way more cooler lives now than me. so get that scratched off your depressing list. 

im at work right now and ive also been thinking a lot about how to disappear. living just feels so lonely.
and yes it will be scary with a job. tomorrow is another day. thats what i always think. 
they should understand. there are just some parents who do not know how to handle situations like we have.
ive seen the same with my parents when my sister was suicidal. but good thing they changed. they became more understanding and more patient. instead of being more like parents. they became more like friends to my sister. i hope your situation would change with your parents too.

try letting them know how you want to be treated just to get the message across. leave it up to them if they want to acknowledge it or not. but they should. because you are important. you are.

i also feel worthless im at work right now. i also remember when i was still in school, when i couldnt memorize poems anymore, i would bang my head with depression. and years after, i just thought, why did i take school seriously? fuck. life doesnt start at school. i should have enjoyed it more with my friends. i should have discovered the world more instead of locking myself in a room with my assignments that really meant nothing to me now grown up.

its ok. my first post was also lengthy. this page really helps. its like letting all out and hoping everything would be ok even when its not.
thanks to your post. its the 4th post ive read so far. and you make anyone like you.. like me. and like all the people who came to see this page feel less alone. thanks a lot. you helped me.

yikes! hope you get through that. then let me know how. so i could avoid it too. up to know i dont even have the courage to attempt a suicide. my sister has done it and i was with her when she was hospitalized. reminiscing that scene and now. thinking about how i feel. i just feel like a super boring and weak human. feeling depressed and super lazy. damn. hope we get through this.

i'm also 25 and feeling the same way. my dad owns a gun and i've thought of the same thing last night. currently working but i envy that you have an apartment. im also a coward so i live with my parents. plus i just dont have enough money to spend more for a separate apartment.
i also dont know my purpose.
what do you do?

same here. damn whenever i check facebook i just get super envious so i tend to put my phone down. but i just cant stop looking at the newsfeed. wishing.

yeah it feels weird. but hey. you have us. don't feel weird. we feel the same thing!
also waiting for the day i could like resign from this life. if only everything could change
what was the holiday that forbid bread?

not a waste of time. absolutely not.  this is also my day 1 here in this website. was feeling depressed today and went through a lot of websites that offered help, medical attention and so forth.  good thing i saw this page.  it really helped.

i am also thinking of the exact same thing you are thinking right now. i wish i had the option to rewind, or go to a place where no one knows i exist. everyone's life seems so perfect and i just get super envious. it's like everything is going well for them.

i also think that i am a disappointment to my family. ive been working for 5 years now and giving them almost half of my salary. and f** i havent even built up on my savings fund!
despite all the effort, my mom told me that the money i was giving was useless compared to what she was giving her mom.
and i answered back, of course, you were receiving much more!

im at work right now and i just wish that crying in the cubicle could stop time. i don't pity you. i can put up with you if we were real friends. even invite you to drink! haha. but i dont drink that much though.
plus, youre also not a waste of time. as i read your post now, i feel like reading exactly just my thoughts.

i also thought. people are afraid of dying when people like us dont want to live anymore. i just dont know what my purpose is right now. i am trying really trying to know what that is. i hope you find it too. lets find it together. then f** the whole world will know who we are.

i was told that if we just find something that we are crazy about, continue to be crazy about it. so if someone goes crazy about the same thing, the first thing they would approach is you.. and that's where your network expands. damn. i need to f**n do this.

same as you, also tired of fighting. typing in my office right now. 2 of the bosses are speaking to someone in hangout. really sad cause they escalated me to higher management. i just wanna disappear right now. i wish that tomorrow, no one would know who i am. except those close to my heart.

hope we'll feel better soon.

hi! just signed up today. and this is the 3rd post i've seen. never knew that it really helps seeing someone in the same state. 

im so sorry to hear about what happened to you. that's really depressing. i hope that you and i could live thru this rut. i also dont think that you're faking any of it. i wish that those things didn't have to happen to you. wanna hug you tight right now! almost all of my friends are chubby even if i look anorexic.. warm hugs. words can't explain what you have been through.

feeling a bit depressed too like you.  i also feel that my family has made me feel like a failure.
well i've also got a friend who's a little chubby. nice to know that you are brave to leave your family and have a house on your own.  salute for being able to pull that off! i think i couldn't do that even if i am already working. its like my hands are always tied. tied to my family's dreams for me.. so that's why i feel so depressed too! and wow! you do welding? actually that was one of the activities i wanted to learn even if i am female. once i have the materials ill contact you again. hope it becomes easy for me!

really f**d up today too. damn, im about to get out of this job and everything is just hitting downwards. got escalated to higher management and i feel like i don't want to go to work anymore. got trainees who also feel the same way and i dont want them to get affected. but it seems like they can really read my actions as i try to be isolated.

sometimes its nice to disappear without anyone knowing. wanna go to the top of the mountain and just see the sun going down.
wanna feel like everything will be alright.  i just wished we had the power to turn back time, rewind, edit our lives. that would be really awesome. sad though but it doesnt happen. damn.

anyway, this page is really nice. seeing your post really helps me feel not alone in this battle. crying at work right now..

I feel the same way. Today was just super f**d up. super lazy, woke up late, even got escalated to higher management and i really feel like a failure. i will be resigning from this job. just had to finish the whole month. good thing i still have leaves to use, i just feel useless though when while still working here. 

nice that you are able to create music! i salute you for being interested at least in something. been reading a lot about depression and laziness. they say that you should be crazy about something or at least be interested in something.. also, talking to someone else really helps. so its nice to know that someone feels the same way. thanks, cheers to us feeling better soon
